ينتجع (form VIII)
# يَنْتَجِعُ (yantajiʕu) /jan.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# يُنْتَجَعُ (yuntajaʕu) /jun.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# يَنْتَجِعَ (yantajiʕa) /jan.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
